title: Number of Zero-Filled Subarrays
summary: Given an integer array, count the number of contiguous subarrays that consist entirely of zeros.
statement: Given an integer array, count the number of contiguous subarrays that consist entirely of zeros.
constraints: Count nonempty contiguous subarrays containing only zeroes.
Nonzero values end the current zero run.
Return the total count across all runs.
hints: Track the length of the zero run ending at the current position.
A nonzero resets that run to zero.
A zero extends the run; add the new run length because that many zero-only subarrays end here.
Every qualifying subarray has one right endpoint and is counted exactly in that endpoint’s run contribution.
editorial: Every qualifying subarray has one right endpoint and is counted exactly in that endpoint’s run contribution.

tests.explanation: Each length-two zero run contributes three subarrays, totaling six.
A length-three run contributes one plus two plus three, which is six.
